Why is genetic drift less important in human evolution at present than it was twenty
thousand or more years ago?

options.A: The human genome has fully adapted to current environmental pressures
options.B: Modern medicine has eliminated the effects of genetic drift
options.C: The rate of genetic drift is directly proportional to technological advancements
options.D: Humans have reached a genetic equilibrium where drift is no longer possible
options.E: Humans have developed immunity to genetic drift

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The human genome has fully adapted to current environmental pressures

questions.stem_text:
The parathyroid glands in man are small, pealike organs. They are ususally four in number
and are located on the surface of the thyroid. What is the function of these glands?

options.A: The parathyroid glands produce insulin to regulate blood sugar levels
options.B: The parathyroid glands regulate blood pressure
options.C: The parathyroid glands control breathing rate
options.D: The parathyroid glands secrete enzymes that break down proteins
options.E: The parathyroid glands control the balance of electrolytes in the body

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The parathyroid glands produce insulin to regulate blood sugar levels

questions.stem_text: Does the type of tibial component affect mechanical alignment in unicompartmental knee replacement?
questions.answer_explanation: Patients who received a metal-backed Onlay tibial component obtained better postoperative mechanical alignment compared to those who received all-polyethylene Inlay prostheses. The thicker overall construct of Onlay prostheses appears to be an important determinant of postoperative alignment. Considering their higher survivorship rates and improved postoperative mechanical alignment, Onlay prostheses should be the first option when performing medial UKR.

questions.answer_explanation: The findings showed that acupuncture of voice-related acupoints could bring about improvement in vocal function and healing of vocal fold lesions.

questions.stem_text: Can elevated troponin I levels predict complicated clinical course and inhospital mortality in patients with acute pulmonary embolism?
questions.answer_explanation: Our results indicate that elevated cTnI levels are associated with higher risk for inhospital mortality and complicated clinical course. Troponin I may play an important role for the risk assessment of patients with PE. The idea that an elevation in cTnI levels is a valuable parameter for the risk stratification of patients with PE needs to be examined in larger prospective studies.

questions.stem_text: Does a febrile reaction to platelets predispose recipients to red blood cell alloimmunization?
questions.answer_explanation: These preliminary data support our hypothesis that recipient inflammation may affect RBC alloimmunization in humans; however, a more detailed understanding of the pathophysiologic association between inflammation and alloimmunization is required before definitive conclusions can be reached.
